title: Andy Burnham to say Brexit ‘has not worked’ and he will sign new deal with EU
summary_full: PM to meet European leaders at summit this week aiming to secure agreements that ‘could raise GDP by 0.4%’Andy Burnham will say on Monday that Brexit “has not worked” and that he will sign a new deal with the EU.It is the latest in a string of comments by the prime minister criticising Brexit, after he told the Welsh Labour conference on Saturday that the UK has “lost more than we gained” through leaving the EU.Is consistent with the Labour manifesto and the government’s red lines.It improves the Brexit deal and brings it closer to what people thought they were voting for in 2016.And it passes the so-called “Makerfield test” by delivering real, tangible improvements in people’s everyday lives.
